summary: Decimal separator inconsistent between the two “< 0.1%” cells of the same table.

rationale: In the same tooltip group about-processes-unload-tab renders “Unload tab” as “Uvoľniť kartu”, about-processes-shutdown-tab renders “Close tab” as “Zavrieť kartu”, and about-processes-kill-process renders “Kill process” as “Ukončiť proces”; here “unload” becomes “close” and “kill” becomes “cancel”, so the icons no longer match their descriptions.
summary: “Unload tabs and kill process” uses different verbs than the dedicated unload/kill tooltips on the same table.

current: Tento profil je používaní inou aplikáciou
rationale: The passive participle must agree with the masculine singular subject “profil”: “používaný”. “používaní” is the masculine animate plural form.
suggest: Tento profil je používaný inou aplikáciou
summary: Agreement/spelling error: “používaní” instead of “používaný”.

rationale: The file-level comment states: “The term 'Service Workers' and 'Workers' should not be translated”. The sk renders it as “skript typu worker” here and in about-service-workers-main-title, -warning-not-enabled, -warning-no-service-workers and unregister-error, dropping “Service” entirely.
summary: “Service Workers” is translated although the file comment forbids it.

rationale: en-US is “Update Directory”/“Update Folder” and the developer comment is explicit: “This message refers to the folder used to store updates on the device, as in 'Folder for updates'. 'Update' is a noun, not a verb.” The sk says “Folder where the application is installed”, which names a different path; both PLATFORM variants are affected.
summary: The “Update Folder/Directory” row is labelled as the installation folder instead.

rationale: The preposition is “pred” (ago), as used in the other variants of the same message (“pred { $hours } hodinami”).
summary: Typo “pre hodinou” in the [one] variant.

rationale: en-US “Enabled by default”; sk says “Enabled in safe mode”, an unrelated condition. The sibling string fission-status-disabled-by-default is correctly “Predvolene zakázané”, so the Fission status readout contradicts itself.
summary: “Enabled by default” rendered as “Enabled in safe mode”.

rationale: en-US “Crash Guard Disabled Features” names the features that Crash Guard has disabled; the sk imperative “Disable Crash Guard features” both changes the part of speech and reverses the subject of the action in a read-only diagnostics table.
summary: A section heading listing features disabled by Crash Guard was turned into a command to disable Crash Guard.

rationale: The standard Slovak nominative plural of “kanál” is “kanály”, as used elsewhere in the tree (e.g. about-webrtc-channels “{ $channels } kanály”).
summary: Non-standard plural “Kanále”.

rationale: “Standard deviation” is the statistical measure (smerodajná odchýlka), not a deviation from some standard; additionally “odchýľka” is a misspelling of “odchýlka”.
summary: “standard deviation” rendered as “deviation from the standard” (and misspelled).

rationale: This labels a column holding the age of each rejected syscall in seconds; the sk asserts a specific vague age instead of naming the unit.
summary: Column header “Seconds Ago” rendered as the sentence “A few seconds ago”.

current: Zapísané do vyrovnávacej pamäti na disku
rationale: The preposition “do” governs the genitive (“pamäte”); “pamäti” is the locative/dative form, correctly used in the neighbouring string “Cesta k vyrovnávacej pamäti”.
suggest: Zapísané do vyrovnávacej pamäte na disku
summary: Wrong case after “do”: “pamäti” instead of genitive “pamäte”.

rationale: “Store” is the Telemetry store being displayed, not the data itself; the sk text is identical to about-telemetry-show-current-data (“Aktuálne údaje”), so two different controls on the page read the same.
summary: “Current Store” rendered as “Current data”, colliding with another label.

rationale: “Keyed” means “having a key”, not “key/important”. The same file renders “Keyed Histograms” correctly as “Histogramy s kľúčom”, so the two sibling sections are inconsistent.
summary: “Keyed Scalars” rendered as “Key/important scalars”.

rationale: The en-US text of this header is “Property”, not “Key”; the sk also collides with the keyed-data terminology used elsewhere on the page.
summary: Column header “Property” translated as “Key”.

current: údaje o výkonnosti a využívaní funkcií
rationale: en-US lists “performance, hardware, usage and customizations”; the sk mentions only performance and feature usage, narrowing the stated scope of what Telemetry collects.
suggest: údaje o výkonnosti, hardvéri, používaní a prispôsobeniach
summary: Two of the four listed data categories are dropped.

rationale: en-US: “This information is submitted to { $telemetryServerOwner } to help improve { -brand-full-name }.” The sk adds “anonymne” (anonymously), a privacy guarantee about what the product does with collected data that the source does not make.
summary: The sk claims the telemetry data is submitted anonymously; the source makes no such claim.

rationale: A Telemetry ping is a data submission, not the network “ping” command; every other string in the file uses it as a noun (“Typ pingu”, “Zvoľte ping”), so this rendering is both wrong and inconsistent.
summary: “ping” treated as a command (“príkaz ping”) although the page otherwise uses it as a data payload.

rationale: Slovak orthography writes the adverb as a single word, “koľkokrát”.
summary: “koľko krát” should be written as one word.

current: systémové dialógové okno prácu so súbormi
rationale: “dialógové okno” and “prácu so súbormi” are juxtaposed with no preposition or case link; a preposition such as “pre/na” is required.
suggest: systémové dialógové okno pre prácu so súbormi
summary: Missing preposition makes the tooltip ungrammatical.

rationale: about-webauthn-credential-management-section-title, -credential-list-subsection-title, -auth-option-credmgmt and -auth-info-max-credential-count-in-list all use “prihlasovacie údaje”, while this row and -auth-option-credentialmgmtpreview / -auth-info-max-cred-blob-length use “poverenia”, so one security-token page names the same object two ways.
summary: “Credentials” is rendered “poverenia” in some rows and “prihlasovacie údaje” in others on the same page.

rationale: The same page uses “Záznam AEC” for “AEC Logging” and “Zachytené záznamy” for the captured logs; introducing a third word (“denník”, alongside “protokol” in about-webrtc-log-clear) for the same artefact makes the controls hard to match.
summary: AEC logs called “denníky” while the AEC controls above call the same thing “záznam”.

rationale: The field holds a DNS name from the certificate's subject alternative names, not a DNS resource record; the neighbouring “Other Name”/“Iný názov” shows the expected rendering of “Name”.
summary: “DNS Name” rendered as “DNS record”.

rationale: The developer comment explains “Inc. means Incorporated, e.g GitHub is incorporated in Delaware”; the sk drops the distinction, so two different certificate fields display under an identical label (the sibling inc-locality and inc-state-province do keep it).
summary: “Inc. Country” and “Country” are both rendered “Krajina”.

current: Vynútiť zobrazenie tretej strany na hlavnom rámci
rationale: The developer comment says the checkbox forces the request “to be treated as third-party relative to the top-level page”; the sk “vynútiť zobrazenie” claims something is displayed rather than classified.
suggest: Vynútiť vyhodnotenie ako tretej strany voči hlavnému rámcu
summary: “Force third-party to top frame” rendered as forcing a third party to be displayed.

current: Zakázať denník JS služby Safe Browsing
rationale: url-classifier-debug-sbjs-modules renders the same “Safe Browsing JS log” as “Protokol JS pre službu Safe Browsing”, and every other log string in the file uses “protokol”; the toggle and the row it affects therefore read as different features.
suggest: Zakázať protokol JS služby Safe Browsing
summary: The Safe Browsing JS log is called “denník” here and “protokol” in the row it controls.

rationale: Back-off is the delay imposed before retrying an update; “čas návratu” (time of return) names something else in a row that sits between last/next update time.
summary: “Back-off time” rendered as “return time”.

current: { $agent } kontroluje kopírovaný obsah v súlade s pravidlami správy údajov vo vašej organizácii.
rationale: en-US: “is reviewing what you pasted”; the separate -clipboard-copy string covers copying. As translated the paste dialog says content was copied.
suggest: { $agent } kontroluje obsah, ktorý ste prilepili, v súlade s pravidlami správy údajov vo vašej organizácii.
summary: Paste operation described as copying.

current: { $agent } kontroluje kopírovaný obsah v súlade s pravidlami správy údajov vo vašej organizácii. Môže to chvíľu trvať.
rationale: en-US: “is reviewing the text you dropped”; the comment states this is shown on drag-and-drop. The sk text (identical to the clipboard variant) names the wrong operation.
suggest: { $agent } kontroluje text, ktorý ste pretiahli, v súlade s pravidlami správy údajov vo vašej organizácii. Môže to chvíľu trvať.
summary: Dropped text described as copied content.

current: aby ste si pripomenul dobitie batérií
rationale: “aby ste … pripomenul” mixes the 2nd person plural with a masculine singular participle; the rest of the string uses the plural polite form.
suggest: aby ste si pripomenuli, že si treba dobiť batérie
summary: Person/number disagreement in the final clause.

current: Server “{ $siteHost }” bol nedávno vymazaný, pretože bol klasifikovaný ako sledovač odchodov.
rationale: en-US: “The state of “{ $siteHost }” was recently purged”; the sibling string correctly uses “jeho stav bude vymazaný”. As written it claims the site itself was deleted.
suggest: Stav servera “{ $siteHost }” bol nedávno vymazaný, pretože bol klasifikovaný ako sledovač odchodov.
summary: Says the site was purged rather than the site's stored state.

current: Čítať nedávnu históriu prehliadania, cookies a súvisiace údaje
rationale: en-US: “Clear recent browsing history, cookies, and related data”. The permission actually lets an extension delete this data; the Slovak tells the user it only reads it.
suggest: Vymazať nedávnu históriu prehliadania, cookies a súvisiace údaje
summary: Permission described as “read” browsing data instead of “clear” it.

current: Chcete povoliť tomuto súboru otvoriť odkaz { $scheme } pomocou aplikácie { $appName }?
rationale: en-US: “Allow this site to open the { $scheme } link with { $appName }?”. The sk is identical to permission-dialog-description-file-app, so the site variant of the permission prompt names the wrong requester.
suggest: Chcete povoliť tejto stránke otvoriť odkaz { $scheme } pomocou aplikácie { $appName }?
summary: “this site” rendered as “this file”, duplicating the -file-app string.

rationale: The comment explains this labels a breadcrumb trail showing the current location in a hierarchy; “konzistentná navigácia” says something else and gives screen-reader users no clue about the control.
summary: “Breadcrumbs” rendered as “consistent navigation”.

rationale: The code cr/en-US “Cree” is the Algonquian language; “Kreolčina” is Creole, a different language entirely.
summary: Cree is named “Creole”.

rationale: en-US “Sundanese” (su) is the language of West Java; “Sudánčina” refers to Sudan, naming the wrong thing.
summary: Sundanese named as “Sudanese”.

current: (napríklad pri hľadaní slova “diéta” nebude ponúknuté slovo “dieťa”.
rationale: The example clause opens with “(” and ends with a period, leaving the parenthesis unbalanced in text the user reads.
suggest: (napríklad pri hľadaní slova “diéta” nebude ponúknuté slovo “dieťa”).
summary: Tooltip's parenthesis is opened but never closed.

current: certifikačnou autoritou, ktorá už nie je nedôveryhodná
rationale: en-US: “issued by a certificate authority that isn’t trusted anymore”. As written the Slovak says the CA is no longer untrusted, i.e. the opposite of the reason for blocking the site.
suggest: certifikačnou autoritou, ktorá už nie je dôveryhodná
summary: Double negation reverses the meaning: “no longer untrustworthy”.

current: { -brand-short-name } nemôže nadviazať zabezpečené pripojenie s touto stránkou
rationale: en-US: “Software is Preventing { -brand-short-name } From Safely Connecting to This Site”. The whole point of the MITM error page — that third-party software is the cause — is lost in the title.
suggest: Softvér bráni aplikácii { -brand-short-name } v bezpečnom pripojení k tejto stránke
summary: Title drops the fact that software is interfering with the connection.

current: Kvôli ochrane vašej bezpečnosti nemôže { -brand-short-name } zobraziť stránku zo servera { $hostname }, pretože táto je vložená do inej stránky.
rationale: en-US: “{ $hostname } will not allow { -brand-short-name } to display the page…”. The sk says the browser cannot display it, hiding that the site is the one imposing the restriction.
suggest: Kvôli ochrane vašej bezpečnosti server { $hostname } nedovolí aplikácii { -brand-short-name } zobraziť túto stránku, ak ju vložila iná stránka.
summary: The refusal is attributed to the browser instead of the site.

rationale: The subject is “Certifikát tejto stránky” in the preceding sentence, which is masculine; “Nebola vydaná” does not agree with it.
summary: Feminine participle refers to the masculine noun “certifikát”.

rationale: en-US: “issued by a certificate authority that isn’t trusted anymore”. The Slovak states the CA is no longer untrusted, contradicting the warning it is explaining.
summary: Double negation reverses the meaning: “no longer untrustworthy”.

current: Zoznam odvolania kľúčov tohto certifikátu zatiaľ nie je platný.
rationale: en-US distinguishes KRL (sec-error-krl-not-yet-valid) from CRL; the sk duplicates the KRL wording, so the CRL error names the wrong list.
suggest: Zoznam odvolania certifikátov pre tento certifikát zatiaľ nie je platný.
summary: Certificate revocation list rendered as key revocation list.

current: Ovládač PKCS #11 porušuje nekompatibilným spôsobom parameter.
rationale: en-US: “PKCS #11 driver violates the spec in an incompatible way”; “parameter” names something the source never mentions.
suggest: Ovládač PKCS #11 porušuje špecifikáciu nekompatibilným spôsobom.
summary: “violates the spec” rendered as “violates a parameter”.

current: Odozva OCSP obsahuje údaj, ktoré platnosť už uplynula.
rationale: “údaj, ktoré platnosť” mismatches number and case; the sentence does not parse in Slovak.
suggest: Odozva OCSP obsahuje údaje, ktorých platnosť už uplynula.
summary: Agreement error between noun and relative pronoun.

current: Funkcia SSL nie podporovaná pre danú verziu protokolu.
rationale: “nie podporovaná” is ungrammatical; the parallel strings in the same file use “nie je podporovaná”.
suggest: Funkcia SSL nie je podporovaná pre danú verziu protokolu.
summary: Missing copula “je”.

current: Partner nerozpoznáva a dôveruje CA, ktorý vydal váš certifikát.
rationale: en-US: “Peer does not recognize and trust the CA…”. Slovak requires the negative on both verbs; as written it reads “does not recognize and trusts”.
suggest: Partner nerozpoznáva a nedôveruje certifikačnej autorite, ktorá vydala váš certifikát.
summary: Negation dropped from the second verb, so the sentence says the peer trusts the CA.

rationale: This is the paper size name shown next to A3/A4/Legal, which are left untranslated here and the printing UI uses “US Letter”; “List” reads as “sheet” rather than naming the format.
summary: Paper-format name “Letter” translated as the common noun “List”.

rationale: The developer comment says “Type is a verb (you can type your name as signature)”; the tab label “Typ” reads as a category, not an action, next to the sibling tabs “Kresliť” and “Obrázok”.
summary: “Type” translated as the noun “kind/type” instead of the verb.

rationale: Every other string in this dialog renders “Primary Password” as “hlavné heslo”; the odd term makes it look like a different setting.
summary: Primary Password called “primárne heslo” where the whole file uses “hlavné heslo”.

rationale: “aj čase, keď aplikácia nie je spustená” is ungrammatical; the locative requires “v”.
summary: Missing preposition “v” before “čase”.
